criteria.detail: 17/17 arms, 85 runs. The stock-flow identity is asserted inside the loop, so reaching here is also the claim that it held in every round of every run.
criteria.name: A13-1  every arm ran and returned a finite share

criteria.detail: promoted 0, demoted 0 across 5 runs. With the switch off `_rewire` is unreachable, so this is the construction itself and every record taken before 2026-08-23 is this arm.
criteria.name: A13-2  the off arm moves nothing

criteria.detail: mobility 0.220184-0.223509, width 0.003325. From A2d's record on the same quantity: sigma width 0.006644, structure width 0.156439. Read: the larger span names what selects the terminal distribution. This criterion prints the three and does not draw a line.
criteria.name: A13-3  mobility's span on terminal top1% wealth, against sigma's and the structure's

criteria.detail: rank alone: rank k=1 cluster 0 200.0, rank k=1 cluster .5 200.0, rank k=1 cluster 1 200.0, rank k=5 cluster .5 200.0 out of 200; with a share: rank k=2 share .001 33.0, rank k=2 share .002 27.6, from an opening core of 20. Read: a rank always has somebody in it, so rank alone admits somebody every round for ever; the share is what bounds the object.
criteria.name: A13-4  the terminal core size, rank alone against rank with a share

criteria.detail: rank k=1 cluster 0 +180/-0; rank k=1 cluster .5 +180/-0; rank k=1 cluster 1 +180/-0; rank k=5 cluster .5 +180/-0; rank k=2 share .001 +13/-0; rank k=2 share .002 +8/-0; demote .005 +0/-2; demote .005 retain 0 +0/-2; both +222/-224; both, degree not conserved +225/-226; both, every 10 rounds +22/-24; demote, inbound cut +0/-2; both, inbound cut +68/-70; both + propensity +234/-236; both + propensity + payroll +180/-182. Cannot fire by construction and excluded: ['demote .005 retain 1', 'off'].
criteria.name: A13-5  every arm that can fire, fired

criteria.detail: demote .005 retain 1 against off, every reading in the row (15 per seed) over 5 seeds, and one SHA-256 per run over the whole history and the state the run ends in, equal in 5 of 5 seeds: identical
criteria.name: A13-5a  retaining every candidate is bitwise the construction

criteria.detail: off 33.132214, and across the mobility arms 17.436912-43.642845. rank k=1 cluster 0 34.307592; rank k=1 cluster .5 40.138301; rank k=1 cluster 1 43.642845; rank k=5 cluster .5 41.441244; rank k=2 share .001 38.11207; rank k=2 share .002 37.190656; demote .005 21.654877; demote .005 retain 0 21.714909; demote .005 retain 1 33.132214; both 23.640868; both, degree not conserved 17.436912; both, every 10 rounds 26.236109; demote, inbound cut 31.511682; both, inbound cut 24.513394; both + propensity 22.683339; both + propensity + payroll 22.467394. Read beside A13-3: the two quantities separate under this mechanism, and which of them moves is the reading.
criteria.name: A13-6  what mobility does move: M/R

criteria.detail: both 224; both + propensity 236; both + propensity + payroll 182; both, degree not conserved 226; both, every 10 rounds 24; both, inbound cut 70; demote .005 2; demote .005 retain 0 2; demote .005 retain 1 0; demote, inbound cut 2; rank k=1 cluster .5 0; rank k=1 cluster 0 0; rank k=1 cluster 1 0; rank k=2 share .001 0; rank k=2 share .002 0; rank k=5 cluster .5 0. Read: leaving what the core sends a demoted node untouched lets its share recover to the promotion condition, so the same nodes cross repeatedly. Cutting the inbound edges closes that, and the count is where it shows. This criterion passes when both kinds of arm are present, which is the only way the comparison exists at all.
criteria.name: A13-7  demotions counted, outbound-only against inbound-cut

criteria.detail: both -> both + propensity: top1% 0.221833 -> 0.221601 (-0.000232); both + propensity -> both + propensity + payroll: top1% 0.221601 -> 0.221554 (-0.000047). Whole ladder 0.221833 -> 0.221554 (-0.000279), against the off arm at 0.222923. Read: the arms before this one buy edges only, so they measure what buying access does. This ladder adds the spending propensity and then the payroll role, one at a time, so each step's difference belongs to the mechanism that step added. The criterion prints the steps and draws no line: what it settles is whether the three mechanisms are separable at all, not how large any of them is.
criteria.name: A13-8  what a promoted node acquires, one mechanism per rung

definitions.claims_moved_after_sample: asset carrier only: the largest change in any one node's claims between claims_recorded and claims_settled.
definitions.core_open, core_close: the core's size at construction, before the first round, and at the close.
definitions.edges_initial, edges_close: edges in the adjacency before the first round and at the close.
definitions.exchange_only_check: the thirteen arms that only exchange edges, with the rounds in which any node's out-degree moved and the nodes whose out-degree at the close differs from the one before the first round, summed over seeds. Both are zero or no record is written.
definitions.held_value_share: asset carrier only: units held at the closing price, as a share of total net worth.
definitions.one_side_of_off: arms that fired and whose difference from the off arm, seed by seed, has one sign in every seed.
definitions.outdeg_moved_rounds: rounds in which the rewiring changed some node's out-degree, counted round by round.
definitions.outdeg_nodes_changed, outdeg_max_gain, o: nodes whose out-degree at the close differs from the one before the first round, and the largest gain and loss among them.
definitions.ruler: A2d's sigma and structure widths from A2d's record on the carrier this record was taken on, one pair per account that record carries. The claims_recorded pair is checked against the widths of that record's grid rows before it is used.
definitions.support, mr_close: effective support and total claims over total resources, in the last row of the history.
definitions.top1_claims_settled, top10_claims_settle: asset carrier only: the same statistics on claims_settled, the claims the run ends with, after the last asset settlement.
definitions.top1_minus_off, mr_minus_off: the arm's five-seed mean less the off arm's, the same quantity as a width and as A13-8's steps. The by-seed lists beside them pair each seed with the off arm on the same seed.
definitions.top1_net_worth, top10_net_worth, gini_ne: asset carrier only: the same statistics on net_worth, the model's net_worth(): claims_settled plus units held at the closing price. true_net_worth(), which also subtracts the uncounted cost, is not read.
definitions.top1_wealth, top10_wealth, gini: shares on claims_recorded: claims per node in the last row of the history. A round's row is written before that round's _post_round hook. On the registered carrier the hook does nothing and the row is the state the run ends in. On the asset carrier the round's asset settlement comes after it, and held units are in no row. The criteria read these on both carriers.
definitions.width_by_seed: for each seed, the largest arm's value less the smallest arm's on that seed alone.
definitions.width_exchange_only: the width of the five-seed means over the thirteen arms that only exchange edges, with the two arms at its ends.
